inspiration: Handheld tabbed terminal: one device screen opened for a stated reason (PipboyOpenIntent enum, pipboy.h line 11) and saved with the game (save_pipboy and load_pipboy in pipboy.h). Recreate as a bottom sheet with icon-first tabs and our own chrome.

Palette-ramp transitions: screens fade by moving the colour table (palette_fade_to, palette.h line 12) rather than by drawing an overlay. Recreate as a tint or colour-matrix tween on our own palette, so the same idea works on a phone without any original art.

Credits as a data-driven roll: one routine takes a data file path, a frame id and a style flag, so the same roll can run forward or in a reversed style (credits.h line 6). Recreate with a scrolled list driven by a JSON file and touch flick.
Several separate systems files (combat, combat AI, party, perk, skill, inventory) show that the game was built as small mechanical modules. Good for structure; do not copy gameplay numbers or text.

Icon-set discipline: Android icons come in five densities (mdpi to xxxhdpi) with round and foreground variants, and iOS takes one 1024 master. Recreate by producing one master and exporting the sizes from it.
